fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 阿嫲说，她在太平山分的那块月饼，软软甜甜的心是莲蓉。莲蓉是用____做的。
questions.explain_en: Lotus paste is made from lotus seeds.

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: On the Peak road a minibus fills Flora's lane while lanterns hang low ahead. The safe choice is to ____.
questions.q_zh: 太平山路上，小巴占了 Flora 的道，前面灯笼又挂得低。安全的做法是____。
choices: toss the backpack at the minibus
switch lanes, then duck if needed
close her eyes and speed up
questions.explain_en: Change to a clear lane, then duck under lanterns.
questions.explain_zh: 先换到空道，再按需要蹲过灯笼。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Peak lookout is 15 m long and 14 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的迎宾地毯长 15 米、宽 14 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 5 trams each carry 8 passengers, and 5 drummers sit on the shore. How many people is that in all?
questions.q_zh: 维港有 5 辆叮叮车，每条有 8 名乘客，岸上还有 5 名鼓手，一共多少人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 18 festival lanterns are shared equally by 3 trams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在维港，18 盏节日灯笼平均分给 3 支叮叮车，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 15 mooncakes sit on the trays at the Peak, and 1/3 of them are sweet bean. How many mooncakes are sweet bean?
questions.q_zh: 太平山托盘上有 15 块月饼，其中 1/3 是豆沙馅，豆沙馅的有多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of mooncakes at the Peak is 11 cm × 20 cm × 16 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 太平山一个月饼礼盒长 11 厘米、宽 20 厘米、高 16 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Near the Peak, Flora buys 2 mooncakes at 15 yuan each and pays with 50 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山附近，Flora 买了 2 块月饼，每块 15 元，付了 50 元，应找回多少元？
